constraints.rule: Claude Code is the only host
constraints.rationale: Pi, the TS bridge, and the Agent SDK split effort and shipped nothing a user can try. Build for one host until the MVP works.
A timeout, model error, or missing store must never block an edit. Log the failure and let the normal permission flow decide.
One write path keeps the store valid. The mod may read .mission/ files directly, but it writes only through bin/mission-ctrl.

constraints.rule: Every LLM verdict is logged with its reason
constraints.rationale: Without a record we cannot tune the judge or build eval cases.
